# Relay 2.0 compatibility

## Worker queue protocols

The Relay 2.0 worker supports reading jobs written with queue protocol 1.8. This statement is about the worker and the wire protocol, not compatibility with every queue server. The Relay consumer is another name for the worker in this example.

Support for queue protocol 1.7 is not documented here.
